name: classic-editor
notes: Adapter-authoring probe 2026-08-22: inspected the official WordPress.org Classic Editor 1.7.0 artifact (SHA-256 7cc7799b0b7d820fbb7528dbff8027c736e52513992416cb37279f44d3d9dd77). The patch-bounded range admits only the observed artifact line.

classic-editor.php activate(), register_settings(), get_settings(), and settings() agree on exactly two single-site settings: classic-editor-replace is classic|block and classic-editor-allow-users is allow|disallow. Both are site-builder choices read directly on every request; neither is an id, secret, cache, or version marker.

The plugin also uses a network option in multisite. Duo's v1 contract refuses multisite before policy load, so this single-site adapter neither captures nor claims the network setting. Exact 1.7.0 conformance proves both per-post editor-routing branches, invalid-value normalization, target divergence, source-faithful uninstall residue, exact reinstall recovery, three-way conflict handling, authorized option deletion, and byte-identical recapture.
